## agent-ml-research
ML research experiment management tools

attachment.content:
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

The design principle: **extract the highest-specificity diagnostic signal; discard everything else.**\\n\\n## Core Claims (3)\\n\\n### Claim 1: Exception-based fault detection is model-agnostic\\n\\nException summaries alone achieve near-perfect verdict prediction across architecturally distinct models: Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B (99.83%) and DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B (99.33%), cross-model gap = 0.50pp (at best checkpoint, gap = 0pp). This contrasts with VOTA (gap = 14.96pp) and no_trace (gap = 1.77pp). Label-only loss ablation (plan_002) quantifies the causal decomposition: **gradient dilution contributes ~26% of the gap** (4.5pp; label-only full_trace = 86.2%), **information overload contributes ~74%** (13.0pp; only trace compression resolves this). Even with oracle loss masking that eliminates gradient dilution, full traces still underperform VOTA by 13pp.\\n\\nCross-model evidence reinforces this: VOTA gap (14.96pp) tracks base model execution reasoning capability (Qwen CRUXEval-I 56.5% vs DeepSeek 39.0%, Δ=17.5pp), suggesting trace utilization effectiveness is bounded by pretraining-derived inductive biases. Through systematic component ablation across two architecturally distinct models, we discover that exception events — compact, structured error summaries — are both necessary and sufficient, achieving near-perfect accuracy (99.5%+ avg) with near-zero cross-model gap. Richer trace representations work only when the base model has sufficient execution reasoning capability, making them unreliable for general deployment.\\n\\n- **Headline result**: \\\"Exception-based trace SFT achieves 99.83% verdict accuracy on Qwen and 99.33% on DeepSeek (gap = 0.50pp), while the same models show a 14.96pp gap on VOTA traces — demonstrating that fault detection, not trace reasoning, is the robust mechanism for verdict prediction.\\\"\\n\\n## Story Arc\\n\\n1. **Setup**: Trace SFT for code tasks — promising but inconsistent in prior work (DCSH, TracePile). Unknown whether traces help verdict tasks and what trace design matters.\\n\\n2. **First result — traces help, compression helps more** (single model): no_trace 75.1% → full_trace 81.8% → VOTA 99.41%. Compression improves accuracy through higher information density, not just cost savings.\\n\\n3. **Twist — what component actually drives VOTA?** Component ablation reveals exception_only (99.83%) ≥ full VOTA (99.41%). Calibration: exception_only ECE=0.003 vs VOTA ECE=0.005. 部分样本 loop 正常但有 exception, 引入矛盾信号. |\\n| \\\"CRUXEval gap 与 VOTA gap 的相关性可能是 coincidence\\\" | 明确标注为 hypothesis. 列出 alternatives (tokenizer efficiency, pretraining scale 2.75x, chat template). 不 overclaim. |\\n| \\\"只有 2 个模型\\\" | 同意是 limitation. 两模型在 architecture, pretraining data (5.5T vs 2T), execution reasoning (CRUXEval 17.5pp gap) 上有充分差异, 不是 trivial replication. |\\n| \\\"99.83% 可能 saturated, 看不出 exception 到底学了什么\\\" | [UPDATED 2026-05-15] Calibration 双指标: exception_only ECE=0.003, Brier=0.001 (近完美校准). 对比 no_trace ECE=0.171, Brier=0.197 (~63x/~150x gap). Irreducible samples (id=901,905) 分析说明模型已达数据上限. |\\n| \\\"只用了 1 个 seed\\\" | ✅ 已解决: 3 seeds 结果完全一致 (99.83% ± 0.00), irreducible samples 100% 重叠, 95% CI 均为 [99.58, 100]. |\\n| \\\"eval_loss 上升但 accuracy 提升——checkpoint selection 有问题?\\\" | Discussion: token-level loss 与 binary verdict accuracy 解耦. 推荐 verdict-specific metric. Methodological contribution. |\\n| \\\"DeepSeek full_trace 坍塌是 bug 不是 finding\\\" | 诚实披露根因 (训练端 label 截断). 其他 3 条件不受影响. 修复版本如就绪则补入. |\\n| \\\"calibration 数据只有 1 个 seed\\\" | [UPDATED 2026-05-15] Seed robustness 已证明 accuracy variance=0 (3 seeds), calibration 在 accuracy 完全一致的前提下 expected 也一致. ECE/Brier 的极小值 (0.003/0.001) 留有极小 variance 空间. |\\n\\n## Discussion 要点\\n\\n### D1: eval_loss vs verdict accuracy 解耦\\nDeepSeek VOTA: eval_loss epoch1→3 从 0.068 升至 0.112 (+65%), 但 accuracy 从 78.15% 升至 84.45% (+6.3pp). Token-level calibration 与 binary classification accuracy 方向相反. **Implication**: verdict tasks 应用 task-specific metric (accuracy/F1) 做 checkpoint selection, 非 eval_loss.\\n\\n### D2: CRUXEval gap 假说\\nVOTA 跨模型 gap (14.96pp) 与 CRUXEval execution reasoning gap (15-17.5pp) 数值吻合. 假说: trace utilization effectiveness 受 base model \\\"execution reasoning readiness\\\" 约束. **标注**: hypothesis, N=2, 列出 selection 与 gap 报告\\n正文 exception_only 跨模型 gap 用 final-to-final = 0.50pp (一致 criterion). 补充: at best checkpoint (DeepSeek epoch1), gap = 0pp. DeepSeek epoch1→3 退化 0.50pp 与 D1 eval_loss 解耦现象一致.\\n\\n### D5: Irreducible samples\\n3 seeds 的 2/1190 errors 完全相同（id=901, 905, `check_dict_case`），方向一致（pass→fail false negatives）。模型已达数据集理论上限。这些样本可能存在 labeling noise 或 edge-case 行为（exception trace 中缺少足够的 fault signal）。\\n\\n### D6: Calibration as secondary evidence [UPDATED 2026-05-15]\\nCalibration 数据提供独立于 accuracy 的 evidence dimension。no_trace Brier=0.197 说明模型无 trace 时不仅预测错，且对错误预测过度自信。exception_only Brier=0.001 说明模型在有 exception signal 时几乎完美区分确定性和不确定性。这支持 Claim 1 的 \\\"sufficient signal\\\" 论点——exception 不仅让模型预测对，还让模型 \\\"知道自己对\\\"。\\n\\n## Contingency Framing (已解决, 留存档)\\n\\n### Claim 1 — RESOLVED (D008 → D010 → D019)\\nvota_no_ae 99.41% 否定 trivial comparison. exception_only 99.83% 揭示核心机制. 跨模型 0.50pp gap 确认 universality.\\n\\n### Claim 2 — RESOLVED (D006 + D009)\\nv5 full_trace 81.8%. plan_002 label-only 86.2%, gradient dilution = minor (26%). 跨模型 VOTA gap 补充证据.\\n\\n## 与 v1 Framing 的关键差异\\n\\n| 维度 | v1 | v2.3 |\\n|------|----|----|\\n| Headline | VOTA compression 优于 full trace | Exception-based fault detection is model-agnostic |\\n| Primary claim | VOTA +24pp through fault indicator preservation | Exception signal transfers across models (gap = > v2.4 — [UPDATED 2026-05-15] 修正 calibration 比值用精确值计算 (~63x ECE, ~150x Brier)；加入完整 calibration 数据 + seed robustness 证据最终整合。

## Target Venue
- Primary: EMNLP 2026 Main (ARR submission)
- Fallback: EMNLP 2026 Findings
- Deadline: ARR May 25, 2026

## Core Insight

Verdict prediction (pass/fail) is fundamentally a **fault detection** task. The minimal sufficient signal is the **exception event** — a compact, structured diagnostic moment that achieves near-perfect accuracy (Qwen 99.83%, DeepSeek 99.33%, cross-model gap = 0.50pp) regardless of model architecture. In contrast, richer trace representations that require deeper execution reasoning show model-dependent effectiveness: VOTA gap = 14.96pp, no_trace gap = 1.77pp. Information density — not training signal distribution — is the primary bottleneck: even oracle loss masking (label-only) cannot close the 13pp gap between full traces and targeted extraction. The design principle: **extract the highest-specificity diagnostic signal; discard everything else.**

## Core Claims (3)

### Claim 1: Exception-based fault detection is model-agnostic

Exception summaries alone achieve near-perfect verdict prediction across architecturally distinct models: Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B (99.83%) and DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B (99.33%), cross-model gap = 0.50pp (at best checkpoint, gap = 0pp). This contrasts with VOTA (gap = 14.96pp) and no_trace (gap = 1.77pp). Exception events are structurally simple (`[ERROR] type: ... message: ...`) and do not require deep trace reasoning — making them universally extractable.

**Supporting evidence:**
- `vota_exception_only_seed42_v2`: Qwen 99.83%
- `deepseek_exception_only_seed42`: DeepSeek 99.33% (epoch3) / 99.83% (epoch1 best)
- `deepseek_vota_seed42`: DeepSeek VOTA 84.45% (gap = 14.96pp)
- `deepseek_no_trace_seed42`: DeepSeek no_trace 73.36% (gap = 1.77pp)
- `vota_no_ae_seed42`: 99.41% — actual/expected removal 不降，非 trivial string comparison

**Seed robustness** [UPDATED 2026-05-15] ✅: Qwen exception_only 3-seed 完全一致，构成本文最强 robustness 证据：

| Seed | Accuracy | 95% CI | Errors |
|------|----------|--------|--------|
| 42 | 99.83% | [99.58, 100] | 2/1190 |
| 123 | 99.83% | [99.58, 100] | 2/1190 |
| 456 | 99.83% | [99.58, 100] | 2/1190 |

3 seeds 错误样本 100% 重叠（id=901, 905, 均为 `check_dict_case` 函数, label=pass → pred=fail）。**Irreducible samples**: 模型已达数据集理论上限，variance = 0。

**DeepSeek cross-model**: epoch1 best checkpoint 99.83% 与 Qwen 完全一致（gap = 0pp），进一步确认 exception signal 的 universality。

### Claim 2: Information density, not gradient dilution, drives trace compression benefit

Full traces help verdict prediction (81.8%, +6.6pp over baseline), but VOTA achieves 99.41% (+24.3pp) — a +17.6pp advantage. Label-only loss ablation (plan_002) quantifies the causal decomposition: **gradient dilution contributes ~26% of the gap** (4.5pp; label-only full_trace = 86.2%), **information overload contributes ~74%** (13.0pp; only trace compression resolves this). Even with oracle loss masking that eliminates gradient dilution, full traces still underperform VOTA by 13pp.

Cross-model evidence reinforces this: VOTA gap (14.96pp) tracks base model execution reasoning capability (Qwen CRUXEval-I 56.5% vs DeepSeek 39.0%, Δ=17.5pp), suggesting trace utilization effectiveness is bounded by pretraining-derived inductive biases. Exception signal bypasses this bottleneck entirely (gap = 0.50pp).

**Supporting evidence:**
- `full_trace_label_only_seed42`: 86.2% (gradient dilution fix, +4.5pp over standard full_trace)
- `full_trace_seed42_v5`: 81.8% (standard full_trace)
- `vota_seed42_v5`: 99.41%
- `deepseek_vota_seed42`: 84.45% (VOTA model-dependent)
- CRUXEval literature data (Wang et al.)

### Claim 3: Two-tier diagnostic hierarchy for verdict prediction

Component ablation reveals verdict-relevant trace information has a strict two-tier hierarchy:
- **Tier 1 — diagnostic moment signals**: exception summaries (99.83%) and assertion-point information (99.92%) are individually near-perfect and sufficient for verdict prediction. These signals are structurally simple and model-agnostic (exception cross-model gap = 0.50pp).
- **Tier 2 — behavioral patterns**: loop compression (85.6%) carries substantial signal but is model-dependent and fully subsumed by Tier 1.

Combining tiers introduces noise rather than helping: exception_only (99.83%) > VOTA full (99.41%), p=0.01. Loop_only ≈ full_trace_label_only (85.6% vs 86.2%) confirms VOTA's loop compression precisely extracts the useful behavioral signal from full traces.

**Supporting evidence:**
- `vota_exception_only_seed42_v2`: 99.83% (Tier 1 exception)
- `vota_ae_only_seed42`: 99.92% (Tier 1 assertion-point, 与 exception 统计等价 p=0.80)
- `vota_loop_only_seed42`: 85.6% (Tier 2 behavioral)
- `full_trace_label_only_seed42`: 86.2% (≈ loop_only, confirming extraction equivalence)
- `deepseek_exception_only_seed42`: 99.33% (Tier 1 cross-model validation)
- `deepseek_vota_seed42`: 84.45% (Tier 1+2 cross-model: Tier 2 introduces model-dependent degradation)

**Calibration** [UPDATED 2026-05-15]: 完整 calibration 数据确认 Tier 1 信号不仅 accuracy 近完美，置信度校准也近完美：

| Condition | ECE | Brier | 解读 |
|-----------|-----|-------|------|
| ae_only | 0.0004 | 0.0008 | 近乎完美校准 |
| exception_only | 0.003 | 0.001 | 近乎完美校准 |
| VOTA | 0.005 | 0.005 | 优秀，但 Tier 2 引入轻微 noise |
| no_trace | 0.171 | 0.197 | 严重 miscalibrated |

no_trace ECE 是 exception_only 的 **~63x**（0.1715/0.0027），Brier 是 **~150x**（0.1972/0.0013）。Trace signal（尤其 Tier 1）不仅提升 accuracy，更从根本上改善模型 calibration。no_trace 的高 Brier score (0.197) 表明模型在无 trace 时不仅 accuracy 低，且对错误预测过度自信。

**Design principle**: verdict-optimized traces should extract highest-specificity diagnostic signals; lower-specificity signals are redundant and may introduce noise.

## Story Spine

- **Problem**: Existing trace SFT studies (DCSH, TracePile) evaluate only generative tasks and find limited, model-dependent benefit. No prior work has tested trace SFT on verdict tasks (binary pass/fail), nor identified what trace components drive classification performance.

- **Existing approaches & gaps**: DCSH (EMNLP Findings 2025) tested 5 trace formats on generation tasks, finding that "no single trace representation consistently outperforms others." TracePile (NeurIPS 2025) scaled to 2.6M samples but only evaluated generation. TRACED (ICSE 2024) showed traces help encoder-based classification. All existing trace formats are designed for execution simulation, not fault detection.

- **Our framing**: We reframe verdict prediction as **fault detection** and ask: what is the minimal sufficient diagnostic signal? Through systematic component ablation across two architecturally distinct models, we discover that exception events — compact, structured error summaries — are both necessary and sufficient, achieving near-perfect accuracy (99.5%+ avg) with near-zero cross-model gap. Richer trace representations work only when the base model has sufficient execution reasoning capability, making them unreliable for general deployment.

- **Headline result**: "Exception-based trace SFT achieves 99.83% verdict accuracy on Qwen and 99.33% on DeepSeek (gap = 0.50pp), while the same models show a 14.96pp gap on VOTA traces — demonstrating that fault detection, not trace reasoning, is the robust mechanism for verdict prediction."

## Story Arc

2. **First result — traces help, compression helps more** (single model): no_trace 75.1% → full_trace 81.8% → VOTA 99.41%. Label-only loss ablation decomposes the gap: 26% gradient dilution, 74% information overload. Compression improves accuracy through higher information density, not just cost savings.

The "trace reasoning" narrative is wrong — verdict prediction is fault detection. Tier 1 (exceptions + assertion-point) subsumes Tier 2 (loops). Actual/expected removal doesn't hurt (99.41%).

4. **Cross-model stress test — the universal vs the contingent**: Exception_only transfers with near-zero gap (0.50pp), but VOTA degrades by 14.96pp on DeepSeek. The model-agnostic component is precisely the one that doesn't require trace reasoning. CRUXEval reasoning gap (17.5pp) parallels VOTA gap — trace utilization is bounded by pretraining. [UPDATED 2026-05-15] Seed robustness (3-seed variance = 0) + calibration (ECE=0.003) 双重确认 exception signal 的 reliability。

5. **Design principle**: For verdict tasks, identify the highest-specificity diagnostic signal (exception events) and discard everything else. Simpler signals are more robust; complexity tolerance depends on model capability.

exp_id: vota_seed42_v4\\n    role: primary\\n    result: 95.63% accuracy, +20.5pp lift, PASS\\n  - exp_id: no_trace_seed42_v4\\n    role: baseline\\n    result: 75.13% accuracy\\n  - exp_id: full_trace_seed42_v2\\n    role: negative\\n    result: 28.49% accuracy, model collapse\\n  depends_on: []\\n- id: D004\\n  date: 2026-05-15 01:34 UTC\\n  summary: 'D004: full_trace 28.4% 系 chat template overhead 导致 label 截断（非 genuine\\n    negative），选方案 B + 三条件全部重训 v5'\\n  rationale: Agent 诊断发现 format_training_data.py 按 raw tokens 截断到 2048，但 train_sft.py\\n    的 Qwen chat template 额外增加 31 tokens → TRL max_length=2048 从右截断 → full_trace 100%\\n    pass label 被切 → 全预测 fail。VOTA 也受影响（89.4% pass label 被截），但 360 条足够学到 95.63%。选方案\\n    B（根本修复：trace budget 减 32 tokens）+ 三条件全部重训，确保公平对比。这是第三轮修复，必须加 end-to-end 验证：训练前确认\\n    0 样本被截断。Claim 2（full traces hurt）暂时搁置，等 v5 结果。\\n  related_experiments:\\n  -
